{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Suriname|Cuisine of Suriname]]

'''Pastei''' is a very old dish and was brought to Suriname by the Jewish settlers. It is a simple dish made from chicken, carrots and peas, and closely resembles chicken pot pie. It is served best with plain white rice.

== Ingredients ==
__NOTOC__
===Dough===
* 200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* 250 g [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Deciliter|dl]] (200 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) cold [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

===Filling===
* 3 large pieces of [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] (drumstick, thigh, breast, etc.)
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely chopped
* 150 g [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] or [[Cookbook:Bouillon Cube|bouillon cubes]] to taste
* 1 fresh [[Cookbook:Chili Pepper|chile pepper]] or [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]] (optional)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaf]]
* Whole [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]
* 1–2 cans of [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]] and [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]
* 2 large [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 1 piece of young [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], chopped
* 3 [[Cookbook:Pickle|pickles]], chopped
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]] (optional)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Piccalilli|piccalilli]] ([[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]] can be substituted)
* 3 [[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|hard boiled eggs]]

==Procedure==

===Dough===
# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] the butter with an electric mixer or a wooden spoon. Keep adding little bits of the water until the butter has absorbed it all. 
# Sift the flour, baking powder and the salt all together and add this through the butter gradually. To see if the [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] is rollable, press your finger on it and if the dough doesn't stick to it, it's fine. However, if the dough does stick, add about 25 more grams of flour. 
# Divide the dough in half, then [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll out]] each piece. 
# Line a buttered [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]] or aluminum foil pan with one sheet of dough. Press the dough to the corners of the pan so that as much filling as possible can go in.

===Filling===
# Wash the chicken if necessary.
# [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] the chicken, 100 g butter, some of the chopped onion, 2–3 bouillon cubes, fresh pepper, bay leaf, and some allspice in about 1–1½ cups of water for 30 minutes. 
# Remove the chicken, and strip it into little pieces, discarding the bones.
# Put the rest of the butter in the broth in which the chicken had been boiled. 
# Heat a little oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]], then add the remaining chopped onion.
# Add the chicken. After a minute add the chopped tomatoes, the peas and carrots, and the celery. Every so often, add a little bit of the chicken broth to the pan so that it won't burn.
# Add the chopped pickles. 
# After all the broth has been added and the whole seems good, taste to see if it has enough salt; if not, add some. Cool slightly, then mix in the ketchup and Worcestershire sauce.
# Transfer the chicken mixture to the dough-lined pan until it is nicely filled.
# [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] the boiled eggs and place them on top of the filling in the pan. 
# Top the mixture with the second sheet of dough. Seal the edges as best as possible.
# Put the pastei in a preheated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]], and bake for about ¾ hour. 
# A few minutes before you take it out of the oven, you can lightly brush the top with some whisked egg to make the top shiny and a little crisp.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If you're on a tight schedule, store-bough [[Cookbook:Puff Pastry|puff pastry]] works just as well, so you can use that instead of making your own dough.
